about: The first launch's preset by graphics card (milestone-1 task 29): the first rule whose pattern (a case-insensitive regular expression) is found in the card's name gives the preset; a card no rule names gets GraphicsPreset.UNKNOWN_CARD_ID (medium). Integrated graphics come first, so a 'Radeon Graphics' never reads as a discrete Radeon.

rules.note: the RTX 40 and 50 series' xx70 and up
RX 6800 and up, 7800 and up, the RX 9000s
GTX 10 and 16 and older discrete cards
